Messages.Author: Raille
Messages.Body:
Vampire Acting is blocked.
Vamp A has a meat hook and SER.
Vamp B has Pot

Vamp A stricks with meat hook after Vamp B decline to use the first
strike option allowed to destroy the meat hook.

As Vamp B strikes with a Pot strike, Vamp A plays The Jones.

Can Vamp B now choose to destroy the Meat hook as a strike? Paying 1
blood as required on the card.

Raille

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>Vampire Acting is blocked.
>Vamp A has a meat hook and SER.
>Vamp B has Pot

Okay.

>Vamp A stricks with meat hook after Vamp B decline to use the first
>strike option allowed to destroy the meat hook.

Just because the strike will be at First Strike doesn't mean that Vamp B has to
declare it early.

Assuming that Vamp A is the acting minion, he chooses his strike first (the
Meat Hook). Then Vamp B chooses whether to use a Pot strike, the destroy Meat
Hook strike, or some other strike.

(If Vamp B is acting, then he has to choose his strike first. So he chooses Pot
strike or Meat Hook strike).

>As Vamp B strikes with a Pot strike, Vamp A plays The Jones.
>
>Can Vamp B now choose to destroy the Meat hook as a strike? Paying 1
>blood as required on the card.

Yes. You choose to destroy the Meat Hook when you declare strikes (just like
how you can choose to use Goratrix's steal blood ability or Lazarus' 1R).

Halcyan 2
